title: tread worn refused
why: The same check on a worn tyre. The coin standing proud is the whole signal, and reading it the wrong way round sends a bald tyre out onto a gravel pass in the wet.

step.title: Check front tyre tread depth
step.explanation: The bikes go out on gravel passes in the wet. Below the legal minimum the bike is both illegal and uninsured, and neither is discovered until after a crash.

field.prompt: Put a coin upright in the main groove and photograph it
field.acceptance_description: a coin standing in the tread groove, with enough of the coin swallowed by the groove to show the tread is well above the wear limit
field.guidance: Close enough that the groove and the coin edge are both sharp.
